report_title: # P0041 ARC12 Uniform Frame-Size Fill Final All-Training Transfer-38 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive P0041 packet measures P0040's frozen generic vocabulary, including uniform-frame size-to-color compatibility, on a newly frozen filename-only all-training cohort of the final 19 disjoint ARC-AGI-1 training tasks plus 19 disjoint ARC-AGI-2 training tasks available after every prior declared roster import. The roster was committed at 905f6ee460bb58436460d82a06fa9f73b3e42bbc before any selected task grid was parsed, visualized, scored, or used for operator design. Selection used only benchmark labels, split names, filenames, and opaque source-byte checksums; it excludes the historical import and every frozen filename-only development and transfer roster through P0040. The reduced 19+19 denominator is a capacity constraint, not a performance choice: no ARC-AGI-2 evaluation filenames and only 19 ARC-AGI-1 training filenames remain under that disjointness policy. The live answer-selection bytes are identical to P0040's c3842b7d28fb2829b79ec815a99b1bc39912a189 source freeze; the only intervening changes parameterize filename-only cohort sizing and add a static roster-boundary test. The live controller receives only each task's visible demonstrations and test input before committing a complete grid. It receives no task ID, cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or held-out test output. This fresh result cannot retune the frozen controller or operator vocabulary. A selected, all-cell-exact uniform-frame result is limited final all-training-subset task-level transfer evidence for that relation; any score is not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim.

implementation_reference.comparison_boundary: P0040 is immutable exposed same-cohort development evidence. P0041 uses a newly disjoint 19+19 all-training denominator, so its score is not a direct numerical delta from P0040. Every live answer-selection source file matches P0040 byte-for-byte.

prior_transfer_reference.comparison_boundary: P0038 is immutable fresh all-training-subset transfer evidence for an earlier vocabulary on a different disjoint roster. P0041 cannot be represented as a score delta from it.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0040's exposed development evidence informed the one bounded generic frame-slot relation. P0041 does not parse selected cohort task payloads during design. The live controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code.

synthetic_contract.coverage: The synthetic contract varies modal backgrounds, frame colors, frame positions, interior dimensions, fill colors, and unrelated components; it refuses unseen sizes, tied backgrounds, non-background interior slots, and conflicting visible size-to-color evidence.

visual_contract.coverage: The future renderer keeps ARC black and magenta distinct and names the frame-size fill relation concisely; immutable earlier diagrams remain untouched.
